question: The Red Fort of Agra was founded by which Mughal Emperor?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Akbar.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Agra fort is near the gardens of Taj Mahal stands the important 16th-century Mughal monument known as the **Red Fort of Agra.**
 
• The Red Fort of Agra was founded by **Akbar**.
 
• This powerful fortress of red sandstone encompasses within its 2.5-km-long enclosure walls, the imperial city of the Mughal rulers.
 
• The forbidding exteriors of this fort hide an inner paradise.
